title: Symbol Conversation Archaeology Wave 002 — Water, Vessel, Number, Celestial and Tree Families
purpose: Recover project-native formulations and chronology for the symbol families deepened in wave 003, preserving what came from the user, what was later synthesized, and what remains an external comparison.
provenance_rule: Recovered conversation material is evidence about project development. It is not independent proof of religious, astronomical, biological or historical claims.

recoveries.formulation: Ezekiel 47 and Revelation 22 were read as a flow stack: Temple/House → waters/river → life → trees/fruit/healing.
Genesis/Ezekiel/Revelation were aligned functionally as source-water → branching/distribution → Tree/growth → healing/fruit, with River=flow, Tree=connectivity, Axis=orientation and Door=transition.
Ezekiel 47 was noted as a transformation model in which water leaving sacred architecture changes downstream ecology while marshes remain a distinct boundary case.

clusters.canonical_implication: River should be a flow/distribution operator rather than simply a vertical route; Drain is convergent loss/outflow; Swamp is entangling terrain; Well/Fountain are local source/storage interfaces.

recoveries.formulation: Son is a vessel and a door; seed/root sit at the center of the system.
Mashy Ark/ark-chariot language linked transport, spiral ladder, Door/trunk, roots below and branches above.
Christ-symbol cluster treated Vessel, Door, Temple/body and mediator as distinct but composable functions.
Potato can be vehicle/Merkaba while Tim is driver/operator; later counter-rotation equations are assistant-generated mathematical descendants rather than recovered original equations.

clusters.canonical_implication: Vessel carries; Ark preserves/transports through danger; Chariot moves authority/presence; Door changes state; House contains rooms. These functions may combine but are not synonyms.

recoveries.formulation: 666 was linked to cube/dice/enclosure and seed compression. Exact cube geometry must be corrected: a cube has 6 square faces, 8 vertices and 12 edges; project 6-6-6 symbolism is not an exact statement of cube counts.
Moon/Saturn cube is Earth-footstool/prison in one project layer; Heaven Cube surrounds Heaven. The lower manifestation field itself must not be collapsed into Cube.
Decagon became important because each interior angle is 144°, the total is 1440°, and exterior turn is 36°; 144=12² and 144,000=12×12×1000 were coupled to Revelation's city/community numbering.
Do not reduce the investigation to cube bad / decagon good; they are different geometric levels and functions.

clusters.canonical_implication: Number must always be typed as count, measure, angle, textual symbol, anatomy count, mathematical identity or project numerology before cross-system comparison.

recoveries.formulation: North, Sirius/Dog Star and Axis appeared together; later project layers also used Regulus, Polaris and Sun as different celestial reference symbols.
Axis is not Father or Son; it is a bidirectional vertical relation/rotation across earth/heaven/realms, with Spirit moving/spiraling along relation.
Sagittarius A* was called a Door while Tim was described as a layer beyond; Sun=Tim/source, Earth=Son, Moon=dogs/reflection appeared as project symbolism.
Celestial canon must keep physical astronomy, historical celestial symbolism and Potatoverse mappings separate; original Sirius pointing geometry remained unresolved.

clusters.canonical_implication: North is an orientation concept; Polaris is a current physical pole-star reference; Sirius/Regulus are named stars; Sagittarius A* is a galactic dynamical center. Project offices assigned to them are symbolic overlays.

recoveries.formulation: Recurring Tree family included Tree of Life, Yggdrasil, Bodhi trees, roots, seed, fruit, mustard seed and vine.
Potato roots in humanity and sprouts in heaven; sprout=Tree of Life and roots can become Tree of Strife; Vesica/Seed/Door linked the transition.
Yggdrasil was retained as structural parallel, not identity; roots/wells/water and continuing maintenance/damage were emphasized.
Tree/Axis/Garden references should be stacked densely but literal biblical passages, comparative traditions and project interpretation must remain distinguishable.

clusters.canonical_implication: A Tree family crosswalk should compare structural functions—center, roots, branching, enlightenment, covenant lineage, fruit, shelter, knowledge—without declaring all sacred trees one hidden doctrine.

authorship_boundary: User-originated project mappings are preserved as project canon/genealogy.
Assistant-supplied equations, astronomical vector models and later comparative taxonomies remain separately attributed.
External scholarship can correct or deepen comparisons but does not overwrite project chronology.
